methodology.question: Does a secondary cadence role improve an already-certified frozen baseline?
methodology.binding: latest secondary cadence as_of <= frozen baseline observation date
methodology.non_overlap: deterministic per-symbol spacing >= baseline outcome horizon on SPY session index
methodology.comparison: role subset versus same frozen certified baseline, same year/horizon
methodology.full_year_support: at least 2 full years and every evaluated full year must pass; partial year supporting only
methodology.neutral_monthly_baselines: excluded from directional CONFIRMING/CONFLICTING role certification
